atlassian.description: Atlassian Remote MCP — provides read/write access to Jira (WW project) and Confluence. Authentication is handled via Atlassian OAuth. Run 'claude mcp add' or connect through Claude Code settings before first use. Replace the Jira project key and site URL in agents/release-note-orchestrator.md if your team's Jira instance differs from the WealthWiseReleaseDemo placeholder used in this plugin.
